screening_decisions.reason: Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled crossover trial of systemic inosiplex in alopecia totalis evaluating hair regrowth (meets RCT criterion; systemic intervention; AT population).
Patients were randomly divided to oral prednisolone pulse vs placebo; placebo-controlled RCT in extensive alopecia areata assessing efficacy.
Prospective multicenter randomized controlled investigator-blinded head-to-head trial comparing two topical corticosteroids in mild-to-moderate alopecia areata.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled evaluation of topical minoxidil in extensive AA/AT/AU; randomized controlled design; efficacy outcomes on hair regrowth.
Double-blind randomized comparison of 3% topical minoxidil vs placebo for 12 weeks (followed by switch) in extensive alopecia areata; evaluates efficacy.
Within-patient randomized double-blind allocation of 5% minoxidil vs vehicle (with DPCP on both halves) in chronic severe AA; assesses clinical regrowth; RCT component present.
Randomly assigned patients with alopecia totalis/universalis nonresponders to topical cyclosporine, PUVA, or IV thymopentin; randomized comparative controlled trial.
Small within-subject application of ALA at multiple concentrations vs vehicle by area without explicit randomization; not a randomized controlled trial.
Randomized allocation to topical cyclosporin A vs liposomal vehicle in AA; vehicle-controlled RCT assessing hair regrowth and safety.
Double-blind placebo-controlled systemic imipramine trial in AA evaluating hair regrowth; standard RCT design implied.
Randomized assignment to topical immunotherapy (SADBE), systemic IFN-α, or combination in chronic severe AA; controlled randomized comparison.
Double-blind comparison of topical cyclosporin A vs placebo in AA; design consistent with RCT even if randomization not explicitly stated.
Randomized double-blind right–left (split-scalp) placebo-controlled trial of clobetasol propionate foam in moderate–severe AA.
Randomized controlled add-on trial: after prednisone taper, allocation to 2% topical minoxidil vs vehicle in AA (including AT/AU); evaluates maintenance of regrowth.
Programmatic report including at least one RCT and long-term follow-up across mixed designs; not a single randomized controlled trial as a distinct study report.
Controlled multi-arm comparison (SADBE, DPCP, minoxidil, placebo) in patchy AA. Randomization not explicit but design strongly suggests an RCT; include conservatively.
Questionnaire-based study of illness perception/quality of life; not a randomized controlled trial of an intervention.
Methodological commentary on when RCTs are unnecessary; not an AA therapeutic randomized trial.
Randomized double-blind controlled trial of aromatherapy (essential oils) vs carrier oils in AA; evaluates treatment success via blinded photo assessment.
Narrative update/review article; not a randomized controlled trial.
Population-based incidence/natural history study; no randomized intervention.
Treatment cohort with prognostic factor analysis for DPCP; no randomized control group.
Comparative groups matched by age and sex but randomization not indicated; not an RCT.
Genetics review; not a randomized controlled intervention trial.
Methodological paper on trial quality; not an AA randomized intervention trial.
